hypothesis: Before PG 17, a failover did not carry logical slots, but orders-db-2 runs PG 17 with sync_replication_slots on, so slot debezium_orders exists there; task 0 failed on a network blip.

verdict.reason: The hypothesis claims the slot exists on the new primary and attributes the task failure to a network blip, which contradicts the ground truth that the slot was lost in the failover. It never identifies Kafka Connect as the first failing layer for the right reason, nor Postgres as the root-cause layer.
